description.sr: Vuk Stefanović Karadžić je rođen 1787. godine u Tršiću, u pravom istorijskom trenutku koji je omogućio njegovu buduću ulogu reformatora srpskog jezika.
description.en: Vuk Stefanović Karadžić was born in 1787 in Tršić, at the right historical moment that would enable his future role as reformer of the Serbian language.

events.quote: koji je rođen u pravom trenutku ... 1787.

title.sr: Vuk boravi kod bogoslovije u Karlovcima
title.en: Vuk stays at the seminary in Karlovci

description.sr: Tokom svog školovanja Vuk je boravio i radio kod bogoslovije u Karlovcima, pre nego što je otišao preko Zemuna u Beč.
description.en: During his education, Vuk stayed and worked at the seminary in Karlovci, before going via Zemun to Vienna.

events.quote: koji je radio teda bogoslovi u Karlovcima.

description.sr: 1818. godine Vuk izdaje u Beču Srpski rječnik, ključno delo svoje jezičke reforme, u vreme kada srpski jezik još nema ni gramatiku, ni pravopis, ni rečnik u modernom smislu.
description.en: In 1818, Vuk published the Serbian Dictionary in Vienna, a key work of his language reform, at a time when the Serbian language still had no modern grammar, spelling, or dictionary.

events.quote: jasno je da Vuk 818. izde taj rečnik, dakle, to se zvalo Srpski rječnik

title.sr: Vukova jezička reforma zvanično prihvaćena u Srbiji
title.en: Vuk's language reform officially adopted in Serbia

description.sr: Vukova reforma srpskog jezika zvanično je prihvaćena u Kneževini Srbiji 1860. godine, mada Vuk nije doživeo da vidi tu konačnu pobedu svog jezičkog dela.
description.en: Vuk's reform of the Serbian language was officially adopted in the Principality of Serbia in 1860, although Vuk did not live to see this final victory of his linguistic work.

events.quote: prva njegova ta vukova reforma je prihvaćena u Karneževini Srbiji 1860.

title.en: Death of Vuk Karadžić in Vienna

description.sr: Vuk Karadžić je umro 1864. godine u Beču, gde je bio prvobitno i sahranjen.
description.en: Vuk Karadžić died in 1864 in Vienna, where he was initially buried as well.
